name: Pill
description: Two-tone capsules, each half a different flat color, tossed across the sheet at every angle like a spilled bottle.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { transform: translate(@r(-12%, 12%), @r(-12%, 12%)) rotate(@r(0deg, 180deg)) scale(@r(1, 1.35)); z-index: @ri(1, 9); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 12%; top: 37%; width: 38%; height: 26%; border-radius: 50% 0 0 50% / 50% 0 0 50%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 37%; width: 38%; height: 26%; border-radius: 0 50% 50% 0 / 0 50% 50% 0; background: @p(var(--color4), var(--color5), var(--color6)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
